name: lysbot-merge-action
description: GitHub Action for automated PR merging with validation checks

scripts.bundle: npm run lint:fix && npm run format:write && npm run package
scripts.package: npx --yes rimraf dist && ncc build src/main.ts --license licenses.txt --minify
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage
scripts.all: npm run lint:fix && npm run format:write && npm run check && npm run package
scripts.all:upgrade: npm run upgrade && npm run all
scripts.all:full-upgrade: npx --yes rimraf package-lock.json && npm run all:upgrade
